critical.body: {path} is {percent}% full. Only {free} free of {total}. Free up space soon.
critical.title: Disk space critical

recovered.body: {path} is back below the warning threshold ({percent}% used, {free} free).
recovered.title: Disk space recovered

critical_threshold.description: Usage percentage that sends a critical notification.
critical_threshold.label: Critical threshold

filesystems.description: One path per entry, optionally followed by ' = label' (for example, '/boot = Boot'). Use \= for a literal ' = ' in a path. Root (/) is included by default and can be removed.
filesystems.label: Filesystems

notify_recovery.description: Notify when a filesystem drops back below the warning threshold.
notify_recovery.label: Notify on recovery

poll_seconds.description: How often to check disk usage, in seconds.
poll_seconds.label: Check interval

warning_threshold.description: Usage percentage that sends a warning notification.
warning_threshold.label: Warning threshold

widget.waiting: Waiting for disk statistics. Check that the system monitor is enabled.
